hypotheses.title: Uniqueness & High IS Score Breakout: 4 High-Conviction Alphas for the Country Leaderboard
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Engineered to overcome the portfolio self-correlation ceiling and maximize the three country leaderboard scoring dimensions (Days of Submission, Uniqueness, IS Score) targeting EXCELLENT and SPECTACULAR status: (1) 3-Year LEAP Call Volatility Term Premium in TOP1000: Evaluates 1080-day institutional call IV over 180-day Parkinson volatility in large-caps with decay=5, compressing turnover and breaking correlation below 0.65. (2) 1-Year Call Volatility in TOP1000 with 10% Reversal: Refines the proven 8/8 PASS alpha (Sharpe 1.87, self-corr 0.6974) by reducing reversal churn to propel Fitness past 1.75 into the solid GOOD/EXCELLENT tier. (3) 90d vs 30d Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope: Measures contango vs backwardation in options pricing (100% orthogonal to levels). (4) Annual Top-Line Sales Yield Valuation: Captures enterprise sales-to-price valuation free from operating accruals, achieving high uniqueness.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if multi-asset volatility slopes reflect systemic liquidity panics rather than firm-specific expectations.
